Chapter 1089: 21: Lin Yuan'S Foundation (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1089: Chapter 21: Lin Yuan’s Foundation (Seeking Subscription)_2

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If it were only a matter of evolving Chaos Yin or Chaos Yang, it wouldn’t be too difficult for Lin Yuan. However, Lin Yuan is not content with merely evolving one path.

Since the Second Layer, he has used Yin-Yang Taiji to forge his foundation, and now as he walks the path of chaos evolving into all things, he naturally still uses Yin-Yang Taiji as the main focus.

As for simply Chaos Yin or Chaos Yang? Even if they are truly evolved, for Lin Yuan, it bears no worthwhile gain, as it would limit future potential.

“Ancestor of Fierce Sun…”

Lin Yuan thought, observing the figure of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun in that crimson world. Although it didn’t directly help him evolve Chaos Yin Yang Taiji, it at least pointed him in the right direction.

This made his future path much smoother, at least giving him a target to pursue instead of aimlessly cultivating and comprehending.

“Continue to comprehend more grand dao rules, elevate the Chaos Rule to the Third Realm, and perhaps the evolution of Chaos Yin Yang Taiji will become gradual.”

Lin Yuan thought, and this was also the realization he frequently gained from observing the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s figure.

Theoretically, the Chaos Second Realm should be able to evolve Yin-Yang Taiji, but it is still just a theory, as currently, Lin Yuan does not observe the possibility of such an evolution.

If that’s the case, then he should continue to elevate his comprehension of Chaos Rule.

The comprehension of the Chaos Rule consists of three realms, and reaching the Third Realm is basically the limit of the Chaos Rule. At this level, one can easily evolve various paths.

“Actually, with my understanding, not perceiving hope for evolving Chaos Yin Yang Taiji indicates that this path has high potential.”

Lin Yuan thought.

Some powers can be evolved with just the Chaos First Realm, like the most common Chaos Flame, Chaos Gold, and so on.

These power paths can be encompassed and covered by the Chaos First Realm.

But some powers require the Chaos Second Realm, being several dozen or even hundreds of times more difficult than the former, yet the eventually evolved power paths will also significantly increase in all aspects.

From this, it can be inferred that the higher the demand for comprehension of Chaos Rule, the higher the potential of the power path.

“Chaos Third Realm?”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed subtly. In the Chaos Void, having comprehension of the Chaos Third Realm is something many Chaos Great Saints might not possess because the requirement for the number of grand dao rules to be comprehended is overwhelmingly terrifying.

But for Lin Yuan?

With the Against-Heaven’s Understanding, comprehending many grand dao rules is not much different from eating or drinking.

Especially in this source world, through the Seed of the Fierce Sun, Lin Yuan’s comprehension of rules has greatly increased, allowing him to perceive the countless rule fluctuations more clearly, and thereby comprehend thoroughly.

“This source world has been incredibly helpful to me.”

Lin Yuan felt a slight sense of gratitude. Without this source world, relying only on cultivating in the Chaos Void, he would likely take many detours.

“If one source world is like this, then the remaining thirty-two source worlds…”

Lin Yuan’s heart was stirred.

Deep within the Myriad Realms Gate, there are thirty-three source world coordinates recorded.

Which means there are thirty-three source worlds.

“Forget it.”

“Descending into this source world already split a small part of my mind and will. Exploring another source world would be too burdensome for my true self, causing significant impact.”

Lin Yuan thought.

After reaching the twelfth layer, Lin Yuan’s life essence was transformed, making further traversal unnecessary to immerse his entire mind and spirit, unlike the more than ten previous traversals.

But it still burdens the mind and will, requiring a small division of mind and will.

For the true self in the Chaos Void, simply splitting a small part of the mind and will to explore a source world has no significant impact.

But if he further splits a small part of his mind and will to explore a second source world… it’s equivalent to only having half of his mind and will left within the true self.

The consequence would be all-encompassing, such as reduced strength, and decreased speed and efficiency of comprehension, among other things.

Exploring a source world isn’t as simple as condensing an incarnation. It requires more than a mere sliver of mind and will. Even with the Myriad Realms Gate as a ‘mediator’, it still requires enough mind and will to maintain the connection between two worlds separated by infinite spatial-temporal dimensions.

“Let’s explore them one by one.”

Lin Yuan knew that haste makes waste. After all, the coordinates for the thirty-three source worlds are there. Once he thoroughly explores this source world…

Or when the exploration of this source world reaches a certain bottleneck, he can consider retracting this part of his mind and will to explore the subsequent source worlds.

…

“After a thousand years of nurturing, my seventh Physical Body Divine Ability is about to be completed…”

Lin Yuan sensed the deep power from the roots of his bloodline intertwining and converging to form an extremely complex imprint that vaguely resembles the Fierce Sun in the sky.

“The amount of time this Physical Body Divine Ability has consumed, I wonder what it will be like…”

Lin Yuan revealed an expression of anticipation. The Physical Body Divine Ability awakened on the Martial Arts Evolution Road depends on the fundamental power deep within one’s bloodline.

Lin Yuan’s physical body originates from the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, with the ancestor’s bloodline flowing within, which is of the thirteenth layer bloodline.

The Physical Body Divine Ability awakened from this has a high probability of being related to the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, possibly being a talent method it possesses.

A talent method belonging to a thirteenth layer life? Even when it comes to Lin Yuan, due to life level and various reasons, the power and effects exerted are greatly reduced.
